name: Dr Web LP
author: Will Oldgram
summary: Builds an HTML and CSS page from a reference image, comparing and adjusting layout, spacing, and proportions.
starterPrompt: Build a responsive HTML and CSS page from this reference image. Match the main layout first, explain any missing assets, and let me review before publishing.
usageNote: Use reference images and assets you have permission to reuse. Test responsiveness and accessibility, and review the generated code before deployment.
